text:
Market at the Park features tribal entrepreneurs
Published 3:00 pm Wednesday, June 17, 2026
MISSION — The next Market at the Park is coming up on June 25, from 4:30-7:30 p.m. at the TxTAYMA Food Truck Park, 46434 Kusi Road. To get there, take exit 216 off Interstate 84 and travel approximately a half mile on Highway 331 — it is between Arrowhead Travel Plaza and Wildhorse Resort & Casino.
People are invited to gather, eat and connect while shopping the food trucks, produce stands and homemade goods featuring Tribal entrepreneurs. Market at the Park is held on the second and fourth Thursdays of each month.
Tribal entrepreneurs interested in vendor information can contact Adrienne Sampson at 458-308-1708 or AdrienneSampson@nixyaawii-CDFI.org. For more information, search Facebook via bit.ly/4xybNcJ.
